company.notes: Long-listed issuer, no IPO in range. listed_since_year=1988 is the earliest year EDGAR filings support for trading in this registrant's common stock. The 1994 proxy performance graph measures common-stock total return from 1988-12-31, and the FY1993 10-K says the stock is listed and traded on the NYSE. No filing reviewed establishes trading before 1988, and the field only marks that the listing predates available price history. The registrant (CIK 19617) was organized in Delaware in 1968 (FY1993 10-K). Its SEC header shows the former name Chemical New York Corp, changed 1988-05-08. EDGAR's name history for the CIK runs Chemical Banking Corp, then Chase Manhattan Corp /DE/ (1996), J P Morgan Chase & Co (2001) and JPMorgan Chase & Co. Bank One Corporation merged into the company effective 2004-07-01 (8-K). Proxies call Bank One, First Chicago Corp. and J.P. Morgan & Co. Incorporated 'heritage' companies. Board service at those predecessors is recorded in notes and not counted in tenure. All directors are elected annually (no classified board).

conflicts.description: Departure day for directors who did not stand for re-election (Bell, Jackson in 2020; Flynn, Neal in 2024). Per the research convention these are recorded as the annual-meeting dates from the 8-K Item 5.07 (2020-05-19, 2024-05-21). But JPM's filings say their terms expired 'on the eve of' the annual meeting, and each director's final Form 4 is dated the day before (Bell and Jackson 2020-05-18; Flynn and Neal 2024-05-20, both no-transaction exit filings). Their last day of service may therefore be the day before the meeting.

How the filings describe Crown's predecessor service. The 2014 proxy and the 2023 internal memo (8-K Ex. 99.1) say 'Director of Bank One Corporation from 1991 to 2004'. The 2020 proxy footnote splits it into Bank One (1996-2004) and First Chicago Corp. (1991-1996). His JPM start (2004-07-01) is the same either way.

Raymond's start. The 2001 proxy says he had been 'a director of the Firm or a predecessor institution since 1987'. Later proxies say 'Director since 2001' plus J.P. Morgan & Co. Incorporated director 1987-2000. Recorded as 2001 (year precision); the 1987-2000 J.P. Morgan & Co. service is predecessor service and not counted.
Raymond's exit: the 8-K Item 5.02 says he resigned effective 2020-12-31; the 2021 proxy says he 'retired in December 2020'. Recorded as resigned, 2020-12-31.

open_questions: Lee R. Raymond's exact 2001 start day is not given in any filing reviewed (year precision only).

Raymond's Lead Independent Director start: the role was 'established' in September 2013 (he had been Presiding Director, a rotating role created December 2006). Recorded as 2013-09 (month); no effective day is stated.
Bell, Jackson, Flynn and Neal: last day of service may be the eve of the annual meeting rather than the meeting date (see conflicts).

Authorized board size: no filing reviewed for 2020-2026 states a board-size resolution. Only nominee counts are given (10 in 2020-2022, 12 in 2023, 10 in 2024, 12 in 2025, 11 in 2026), so no BOARD_SIZE_CHANGE events are recorded.

Committee membership is captured at proxy snapshots (2026 for current directors; each departed director's last proxy). Mid-year changes are only partly disclosed. For example, the early-2026 changes (Rometty to Governance Chair; Gorsky and Buck to Governance; Smith and Boler Davis to PRC) are not dated. Specific Purpose Committee memberships (e.g., Markets Compliance, Omnibus) are not captured because the text tables lose their columns.

Independence spans for current directors are aligned to board tenure from point-in-time proxy determinations (medium confidence). Departed directors' independence is stated retrospectively in later proxies.

Listing: the earliest EDGAR support for common-stock trading is the 1994 proxy performance graph, measured from 1988-12-31, together with the FY1993 10-K's NYSE listing statement. The registrant was organized in 1968 (then Chemical New York Corp), but no filing reviewed dates the start of its listing. Predecessor J.P. Morgan & Co. Incorporated was a different registrant and is not used.

Other-board lists come from JPM's own bios as of each filing and are not checked against the other issuers' filings. Departed directors' entries reflect status as of their last bio (2019 for Bell and Jackson, 2023 for Crown, Flynn and Neal, 2025 for Combs).

coverage.method: Current roster taken from the 2026 DEF 14A (filed 2026-04-06) and the 2026-05-19 annual-meeting 8-K (Item 5.07). Checked against every 8-K filed 2026-04-06 to 2026-10-02 (all items, including the 5.02 of 2026-06-25, which covers officers only, and the 5.03 by-law changes), plus the EDGAR Form 3 list through 2026-10-02. No director joins or leaves after the proxy.

Every DEF 14A from 2020 to 2026 and every 8-K/8-K/A with Item 5.02 or 5.07 filed 2019-12 to 2026-10 reviewed from the EDGAR submissions feed. Nominee counts were reconciled year by year. EDGAR full-text search was run over 2020-2026 8-Ks for director deaths, resignations and elections; this found the Crown death 8-K (Item 8.01) and the 2020 LID 8-K (Item 8.01). Pre-2020 start dates come from the original 8-Ks and Forms 3.
